newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA PUT ZIMBABWE IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA PUT ZIMBABWE IN TO BAT.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and put
Zimbabwe in to bat in the fifth limited-overs cricket match in
the Singer world series tournament on Tuesday.
Zimbabwe - Alistair Campbell (captain), Andy Flower, Craig
Evans, Grant Flower, Paul Strang, Heath Streak, Andrew Whittall,
Guy Whittal, Craig Wishart, Wayne James, Henry Olonga.
Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya,
Romesh Kaluwitharana, Asanka Gurusinha, Aravinda de Silva,
Hashan Tillekeratne, Muthiah Muralitharan, Upul Chandana, Marvan
